# Pre-market brief, Fri Oct 16, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:27 AM ET)

**Tone: Mixed futures; AI-debt cracks persist; TSLA Roadster pop; Warsh cuts Oct hike odds to ~15%; Brent still >$100. Defensives over AI into opex/data.**

1. **Futures mixed; SPX/NDX weekly losses on tap:** ~6:21 ET Dow e-minis +204 (+0.39%), ES +12.5 (+0.16%), NQ −23.5 (−0.08%). Box ~8:25 ET: ES −0.06%, NQ −0.34%, YM −0.23%. ([Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/wall-st-futures-mixed-tech-wobbles-again-tesla-gains), box yfinance)
2. **Warsh Bangkok — no Oct signal:** AI “most consequential”; demand before supply; won’t prejudge 10/28. Oct hike odds ~15% (from ~27–28%). ([Straits Times](https://www.straitstimes.com/business/warsh-boosts-market-expectations-of-fed-rate-hold-in-october), [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-10-16-2026/card/investors-trim-bets-on-fed-october-hike-after-warsh-comments-vpQa8sUdJa9Jzzxz0Fj2))
3. **AI debt / memory soft:** CRWV −3–4% pre after Thu bounce; MU ~−1.1%; China DRAM supply fears. ([Investing.com](https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-tesla-jumps-strategy-falls-on-msci-index-threat-2740192), [Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/wall-st-futures-mixed-tech-wobbles-again-tesla-gains), [X](https://x.com/i/trending/2110894838711570502), box yfinance)
4. **Movers:** TSLA ~+3.5–5% on Roadster thruster demo (prod 2028). NFLX ~−2% on Peter Rice CCO hire. XOM flagged Q3 margin/commodity hits vs Q2. ([Investing.com](https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-tesla-jumps-strategy-falls-on-msci-index-threat-2740192), [FirstSquawk](https://x.com/FirstSquawk/status/2111067450209186261), box yfinance)
5. **Oil / rates / BTC:** Brent ~$105–106 (still >$100), WTI ~$96–97; 10y ~5.09%; BTC ~$82.2k; VIX ~16.0 (box). Hormuz premium intact. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/16/oil-edges-down-as-investors-weigh-possible-us-sanctions-on-shadow-fleet.html), [Investing.com](https://au.investing.com/news/commodities-news/oil-prices-edge-lower-on-improving-supplies-wti-set-for-strong-week-4693905), box yfinance)

**Today/week:** Import/export prices 8:30 ET ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/mxp/)); industrial production 9:15 ([Fed G.17](https://www.federalreserve.gov/Releases/g17/)); monthly opex. FOMC 10/28. Earnings: NFLX 10/20 AMC; TSLA / IBM / META 10/21 AMC ([Earnings Whispers](https://www.earningswhispers.com/calweek/20261019)).

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **UNH**, swing: defensive HC hold after 2026 EPS raise; still green pre. Conf: med. Risk: MA/policy; extended.
- **BLK**, swing: AUM/inflows bid while AI soft (~+0.7% pre). Conf: med. Risk: equity drawdown hits fees.
- **WMT**, swing: DB Buy still valid; staples in hot-inflation tape. Conf: low. Risk: gap fade; multiples compress.

**Avoid:** airlines (Brent >$100); AI optics; CRWV/ORCL (AI debt); BAC (AML overhang).
